# The Coop Finder – Tessa Hood, Oklahoma Realtor

Tessa Hood is a licensed Realtor with Knight Land Company serving buyers and sellers in Newcastle, Tuttle, Blanchard, and the South OKC metro. The Coop Finder is her personal real-estate brand focused on local knowledge, honest guidance, and community.
